name: TRAMADOL 100MG/1ML SOLUTION DROPS 10 ML 1 PIECE
description: They are used as a short-term treatment to relieve severe pain (pain that begins suddenly, has a specific cause, and is expected to disappear when the underlying cause is cured) in people who are expected to require an opioid pain reliever and whose pain cannot be controlled by alternative pain relievers. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
